AudioFormat.description: A stream format, as in the mount `/stations/{id}/live.{mp3,opus}`.

ingestUrl.description: Where to publish (HTTP PUT, Icecast source protocol, TLS).

publicId.description: Station ID in mounts and listener URLs.

stationName.description: Station name, e.g. for the `Ice-Name` header.

credentialId.description: The device's broadcast credential, listed under the station's credentials.

username.description: Source username: the station's public ID.

password.description: Source password of this device. Shown only here: store it now. Asking again replaces it.

maxBitrateKbps.description: Highest bitrate the plan accepts, per stream.

outputs.description: Streams the plan allows, MP3 first.

BroadcastTargetResponse.description:
Everything the desktop app needs to go live on a station. Contract version 1 (docs/desktop-api.md); it never
contains node, admin or relay credentials.

deviceLabel.description: Names the device, e.g. "Studio PC"; unique among the station's active credentials.

CreateCredentialCommand.description: Issues a broadcast credential for one device of a station.

slug.description: URL name, unique in the tenant, e.g. "radio-mada".

description.description: Shown on the public page and in directories.

logoUrl.description: HTTPS address of a square logo.

listInDirectory.description: List on RadioBrowser, if the plan includes it.

CreateStationCommand.description: Creates a station in the current tenant.

slug.description: URL name, unique across Tropicast, e.g. "radio-mada".

CreateTenantCommand.description: Creates a tenant; the caller becomes its Owner.

deviceLabel.description: The device it was issued for.

lastUsedAt.description: Last accepted connection from Icecast; null if never used.

revokedAt.description: When it was revoked; null while active.

CredentialResponse.description: A broadcast credential, without its secret.

deviceCode.description: Secret: send it to `/auth/device/token` only. Never show it.

userCode.description: Short code the user types on the web page, e.g. `BCDF-GHJK`.

verificationUri.description: Web page where the user enters the code.

verificationUriComplete.description: The same page with the code filled in, e.g. for a button or a QR code.

DeviceCodeResponse.description: A started desktop sign-in. Show string DeviceCodeResponse.UserCode and Uri DeviceCodeResponse.VerificationUri, then poll.

userCode.description: The code, as the device shows it.

deviceName.description: Name the device gave itself; it becomes the device's name in the account.

DeviceRequestResponse.description: A pending desktop sign-in, shown to the user before they approve it.

email.description: Address to invite; the invitee accepts after signing in with it.

oneOf.description: Required: there is no default role.

username.description: Icecast source username: the station's public ID.

secret.description: Icecast source password. Store it in the device now; it cannot be shown again.

IssuedCredentialResponse.description: A new credential with its secret. This response is the only time the secret is shown.

opus.description: Ogg Opus stream: about half the mobile data of MP3.

ListenerUrls.description: Listener URLs of a station. Uri? ListenerUrls.Opus is null when the plan has no Opus.

MemberResponse.description: A member of the current tenant.

tenantId.description: Send it as `X-Tenant-Id` when asking for the broadcast target.

publicId.description: Station ID in mounts and listener URLs.

role.description: The user's role in the tenant.

MyStationResponse.description: A station the signed-in user can broadcast to.

publicId.description: ID in listener URLs and Icecast mounts; never changes.

slug.description: URL name, unique in the tenant.

description.description: Shown on the public page and in directories.

listInDirectory.description: Listed on RadioBrowser (only when the plan includes it).

inSync.description: The node runs the desired station limits.

desiredVersion.description: Version of the limits the database asks for.

appliedVersion.description: Version last applied to the node.

id.description: Tenant ID; send it as X-Tenant-Id to choose this tenant.

stationCount.description: Stations in use, out of Plan.MaxStations.

refreshToken.description: One-time: each refresh returns a new one. Revoke it to sign the device out.

TokenResponse.description: Tokens for the desktop app: string TokenResponse.AccessToken lasts 15 minutes; refresh to get a new pair.
